title: Psychedelic Crystal Ball
description: A glowing crystal ball sits on a wooden table, its interior revealing a surreal coastal landscape with rocks and water. At its center is a vibrant, multicolored eye with a black pupil, surrounded by branching neon energy tendrils in pink, blue and purple that drip paint onto the base and table, with scattered paint tubes nearby.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal crystal ball on a wooden table, inside it a vibrant multicolored eye with black pupil at the center of glowing blue and pink neural energy tendrils, a coastal rocky beach landscape visible within the sphere, neon paint dripping down the glass, scattered paint tubes on the table, dark background with dramatic lighting, psychedelic and mystical atmosphere
